decisions.reason: Launched only in 2023 and publicly presented on the website, the healthcare and hospitality recruitment service has had too little time to prove itself, so weak early results can be put down to start-up effects and management will likely persist to justify the diversification it chose.

The superyacht crew recruitment service is a niche far from the core logistics business, which makes it a little more vulnerable, but its recent public launch and the start-up costs already incurred favour giving it another year rather than reversing the decision.
